# Axure integrations

Streamline the way you create and share UX prototypes with your team

![](https://www.axure.com/_ipx/f_webp/images/2026/01/integrations.png)

![](https://www.axure.com/_ipx/f_webp/images/2021/03/team_left.png)

Get your team on the same page

Embed fully-functional Axure prototypes directly into Jira and Confluence, and use our Microsoft Teams and Slack integrations to keep everyone up to date on the latest activity.

![](https://www.axure.com/_ipx/f_webp/images/2021/03/team_right.png)

[![](https://www.axure.com/_ipx/f_webp/images/2021/04/text-blocks-jira.png)](https://www.axure.com/blog/embed-axure-prototypes-in-jira-tickets)

[**Jira**](https://www.axure.com/blog/embed-axure-prototypes-in-jira-tickets)

With Axure for Jira, your team can easily access up-to-date UX and design resources within Jira. Add as many prototypes as needed to Jira tickets and ensure that developers have quick access to the latest designs.

[Get Axure for Jira](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/1221645/axure-for-jira) [Learn more](https://www.axure.com/blog/embed-axure-prototypes-in-jira-tickets)

[![](https://www.axure.com/_ipx/f_webp/images/2021/04/text-blocks-confluence.png)](https://www.axure.com/blog/embed-axure-prototypes-in-confluence)

[**Confluence**](https://www.axure.com/blog/embed-axure-prototypes-in-confluence)

Experience advanced RP prototypes without leaving Confluence. Preview your interactive prototypes alongside other assets in Confluence, giving teammates quick access to the latest designs. Just paste in your Axure Cloud link.

[Get Axure for Confluence](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/1223048/axure-for-confluence?hosting=cloud&tab=overview) [Learn more](https://www.axure.com/blog/embed-axure-prototypes-in-confluence)

[![](https://www.axure.com/_ipx/f_webp/images/2021/04/text-blocks-slack.png)](https://docs.axure.com/axure-cloud/reference/notifications/#slack)

[**Slack**](https://docs.axure.com/axure-cloud/reference/notifications/#slack)

With the Axure Cloud Slack app, get notified in Slack of all activity on your Axure Cloud projects: new comments for all projects, and check-ins and changes to your team projects

[Learn more](https://docs.axure.com/axure-cloud/reference/notifications/#slack)

[![](https://www.axure.com/_ipx/f_webp/images/2021/04/text-blocks-ms-teams.png)](https://docs.axure.com/axure-cloud/reference/notifications/#microsoft-teams)

[**MS Teams**](https://docs.axure.com/axure-cloud/reference/notifications/#microsoft-teams)

With the Axure Cloud Microsoft Teams app, you can get notified in Teams of all activity on your Axure Cloud projects. Get notified of any new comments, project updates, or changes.

[Learn more](https://docs.axure.com/axure-cloud/reference/notifications/#microsoft-teams)

## Quickly bring designs into Axure RP

Copy and paste assets from Figma, Sketch, and Adobe XD and more into Axure RP or publish directly to Axure Cloud.

[![](https://www.axure.com/_ipx/f_webp/images/2021/04/text-blocks-figma.png)](https://www.axure.com/blog/import-figma-designs-into-axure)

[**Figma**](https://www.axure.com/blog/import-figma-designs-into-axure)

Copying frames from Figma to Axure RP lets you quickly bring your designs to life with the powerful prototyping capabilities of Axure RP. Simply select your frames in Figma and use this plugin to copy them.

[Get Figma plugin](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/837098402230990991/axure) [Learn more](https://www.axure.com/blog/import-figma-designs-into-axure)

[![](https://www.axure.com/_ipx/f_webp/images/2021/04/text-blocks-sketch.png)](https://www.axure.com/blog/import-sketch-designs-into-axure-rp)

[**Sketch**](https://www.axure.com/blog/import-sketch-designs-into-axure-rp)

The Axure plugin for Sketch allows you to easily copy artboards out of Sketch and bring layers into Axure RP as individual widgets. Once in Axure, all of your Sketch assets will be editable and ready for building interactions.

[Get Sketch plugin](https://www.axure.com/misc/sketch/Axure.sketchplugin.zip) [Learn more](https://www.axure.com/blog/import-sketch-designs-into-axure-rp)

[![](https://www.axure.com/_ipx/f_webp/images/2021/04/text-blocks-adobe.png)](https://www.axure.com/blog/import-adobe-xd-designs-into-axure)

[**Adobe XD**](https://www.axure.com/blog/import-adobe-xd-designs-into-axure)

Easily copy layers from XD to Axure RP or publish artboards directly to Axure Cloud. Copying layers from XD to Axure RP lets you quickly bring your designs to life with the powerful prototyping capabilities of Axure RP.

[Get Adobe XD plugin](https://adobe.com/go/xd_plugins_discover_plugin?pluginId=2d46a4a0) [Learn more](https://www.axure.com/blog/import-adobe-xd-designs-into-axure)

![Axure RP Icon](https://www.axure.com/_ipx/f_webp/images/2026/01/Axure_RP_icon.png)
